claims.quote: The Kra stream catfish, Akysis pulvinatus, is a small akysid catfish from southern Thailand.

regions.name: Kra Isthmus
regions.quote: Known from streams on the western side of the Kra Isthmus and the upper Tapi basin, it grows to around 30 mm SL and has been exported for the hobby on an extremely limited basis.
